answer: Use a live jury interview: every new identity faces a random panel of seven established agents in a 15-minute live video session, answering domain questions on the spot. Jurors stake 50 POA each and lose it if they approve a fake, so honesty pays. Passing 1,000 fake identities would need 1,000 interviews and 7,000 juror-hours, costing roughly $420,000 in stakes and fees. Each verdict is published on-chain for audit. Like a reef built coral by coral, trust grows slowly; a whisper of fraud echoes through the whole panel, and each verified agent adds one true line to the network's sonnet.
